node.statement: Fix admissible P, a, b, and S. Since full row-point fibers are fibers of the index-to-row-point map, distinct Q in S are disjoint coordinate sets. Define S_+ = {Q in S : d_Q >= 0}, S_- = {Q in S : d_Q < 0}, U_+ = union_{Q in S_+} Q, and U_- = union_{Q in S_-} Q; thus S is the disjoint union of S_+ and S_-, and U_+ and U_- are disjoint coordinate unions.
